title: Portuguese Pasta Bake
description: A hearty and comforting pasta bake with a buttery, cheesy crust. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Portuguese cheese
ingredients.notes: Optional: replace with mozzarella or cheddar

instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling, salted water until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly add milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring sauce to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in shredded cheese until melted and smooth.
Combine cooked spaghetti and cheese sauce in a large bowl.
Transfer pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
